title: public error enums missing #[non_exhaustive]: adding variants is a breaking change
description: ValidationError, ProtocolError, StorageError, SigningError in core/src/error.rs are all public enums without #[non_exhaustive]. Any future variant addition is a semver-breaking change because downstream match arms would need a wildcard. Annotate all four with #[non_exhaustive] before the first published release.
